body: Adversarial review round 4 (codex, high) showed that hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs workerScopeVerdict authorises a headless worker mutation from resolveTicket() in lib/active-rails.mjs, which reads whatever backend @adlc/tickets loads, including a retired legacy .adlc/tickets.json. A stale or attacker-supplied legacy ticket with a broad scope could widen a worker authorised mutation scope even though agb plan/run now refuse a legacy store. Fix: resolveTicket returns { ok:false, error: LEGACY_TICKET_STORE ... adlc ticket store migrate } whenever .adlc/tickets.json exists (lstat, so a dangling symlink counts) before any scope is read; workerScopeVerdict already denies when resolution fails. unionActiveRails (deny-only rails union) is deliberately unchanged: a legacy store there can only add protected paths. Add regression tests in test/active-rails.test.mjs (legacy-only, legacy plus directory store, dangling symlink) and a worker-scope test through the pre-tool-use policy path in test/pre-tool-use.test.mjs; rebuild dist so the shipped hook bundle carries the fix. Acceptance: npm test green; the new tests fail without the fix.
title: Headless worker scope must not be authorised from a legacy ticket store
